apps.name: ByeTunes
apps.localizedDescription:
ByeTunes 🎵
Say goodbye to iTunes sync!
ByeTunes is a native iOS app that lets you inject music (MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV) and ringtones directly into your device's media library—without needing a computer connection for every sync. It communicates directly with the iOS media database, giving you the power to manage your music on your terms.
Features

Direct Music Injection: Add songs to your Apple Music library without a PC.
(DISABLED FOR NOW) Ringtone Manager: Inject custom ringtones (.m4r and .mp3 auto-conversion).
Playlist Support: Create and manage playlists on the fly.
No Computer Needed (after setup): Once paired, you're free!
Metadata Editing: Auto-fetched from iTunes or Deezer.

Compilation Instructions
To build ByeTunes yourself, you'll need a Mac with Xcode.
Prerequisites

Xcode: Version 15+ recommended.
iOS Device: Running iOS 16.0 or later.

External Libraries
ByeTunes relies on idevice (a libimobiledevice alternative) to talk to the iOS internal file system. These files are NOT included in this repository for licensing/size reasons.
To compile the app, you need to obtain these two files and place them in the MusicManager/ directory:

libidevice_ffi.a (Static Library)
idevice.h (Header File)

You can find idevice and compile it from here: https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice
If you don't have these files, the project will not compile.
Backend Configuration
ByeTunes talks to a backend for downloads and metadata. The app reads the backend address from MusicManager/Config.plist, which is not included in this repository.

Copy Config.example.plist to MusicManager/Config.plist.
Replace the placeholder value of ByeTunesApiUrl with the address of your own backend.

Without this file the app falls back to a local placeholder address and downloads will not work.
Build Steps

Install Rust:
    bash
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh

Add the ios Arch:
    bash
    rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios


Install Xcode Command Line Tools if you don't have it already installed:
    bash
    xcode-select --install


Clone the repo:
    bash
    git clone https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice


Set a deployment target:
    bash
    export IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=xx.x


Run the cargo build:
    bash
    cargo build --release --package idevice-ffi --target aarch64-apple-ios
Inside the idevice folder find: idevice.h and libidevice_ffi.a. Move them inside the project in Xcode, make sure you create Bridging-Header.h
Inside your Xcode project and make sure you add:


bash
    #import "idevice.h"
In Project Settings > Build Phases > Link Binary With Libraries, make sure libidevice_ffi.a is listed.
How to Use


LocalDevVPN:

Download LocalDevVPN from the App Store/Altstore PAL https://apps.apple.com/us/app/localdevvpn/id6755608044.
Open it and tap Connect, you will need an active connection to import the pairing file inside the app.



Pairing:

On first launch, you'll see an "Import Pairing File" screen.
You need to get a pairing file.
Download idevice_pair refer to https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice_pair .
Generate you pairing file.
Export it from your computer and Airdrop/Save it to your iPhone.
Import it into ByeTunes.



Add Music:

Tap "Add Songs" and select files from your Files app.
Hit "Inject to Device" and watch the magic happen.



Ringtones:

Go to the Ringtones tab, add your file, and inject!



Notes

Signed Apps: If you install this via a signing service (Signulous, AltStore, etc.), the app includes a fix (asCopy: true) to ensure file importing works correctly without crashing.
Backup: Always good to have a backup of your music library before messing with database injection!

License & Hosted Backend
The source code is licensed under the MIT License.
The official ByeTunes download/metadata server is a separate hosted service and is not covered by that license. You are welcome to fork, modify and share ByeTunes under the MIT License, but modified builds must run their own backend instead of using the official one. Linking to this repository's releases is preferred over re-uploading them. See BACKEND_TERMS.md for details.
Support & Bug Reporting
Found a bug? We'd love to fix it!

Report Issues: Open a ticket on GitHub Issues.
Join the Community: Chat with us on Discord.
Attach Debug Logs:
If you are experiencing injection failures, please use the Debug Options under delte library inside settings.
This includes a "Debug Logs" screen where you can copy the app logs.
Please attach these logs to your issue report—they help us solve problems much faster!

- Fixed random "Access denied" errors

- Fixed playback issues
- Improved support for legacy versions
- Improved opening of videos from links

Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. Console, handheld, arcade, computer, and mobile classics live in one library. The app does not include games, BIOS, or game data. Use only legally owned backups, homebrew, or public-domain software.

Supported Platforms

Nintendo
- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
- Nintendo GameCube (NGC)
- Nintendo Wii (Wii)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Virtual Boy (VB)
- Pokemon Mini (PM)

Sony
- PlayStation (PS1)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)

Sega
- Dreamcast (DC)
- Sega Saturn (SS)
- Sega Master System (MS)
- Game Gear (GG)
- SG-1000 (SG)
- Sega Genesis 32X (32X)
- Sega CD / Mega-CD (MCD)
- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (MD)

NEC
- PC Engine (PCE)
- TurboGrafx-16 (TG-16)
- TurboGrafx-CD (TG-CD)
- SuperGrafx (SGX)

SNK
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGPC)

Atari
- Atari 2600
- Atari 5200
- Atari 7800
- Atari Jaguar
- Atari Lynx

Commodore
- Commodore 64 (C64)
- Amiga

Other
- Arcade
- DOOM
- MS-DOS
- Java ME (J2ME)
- Symbian

More systems are planned.

[RetroAchievements]
- Challenge players worldwide and light up trophies that are yours
- Multiset: grind multiple sets on one game — earn subset trophies without patching
- Hardcore Mode: tougher rules, trophies that actually count

[Save States, Your Way]
- Unlimited manual save states plus 50 auto slots
- Save Manager: browse by time, compare, and restore in one tap

[Speed, Cheats & Shortcuts]
- 5x fast forward — you set the pace
- Cheats on demand from an online library
- Custom shortcuts for save, speed, and screenshots

[Filters, Skins & Screenshots]
- Retro filters from our exclusive library
- Skins that feel like real hardware, third-party skins welcome, flex layouts that fit your hands
- Screenshots for the highlight reel

[Landscape Library]
- Landscape console mode — library, covers, and shortcuts on one screen
- Background music and navigation sounds — browsing feels like an arcade
- Browse with a controller or keyboard — stay on the couch

[Play Together]
- Local multiplayer whenever you want
- Eligible cores can host rooms, scan LAN, connect over relay, and spectate

[Cloud Import in One Step]
- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, Aliyun
- WebDAV and SMB too — bring the whole library over in one go

[Controllers Your Way]
- Native Joy-Con, DualShock, and Xbox support
- Bluetooth controllers and keyboards — play on Mac too
- Multiple controllers at once, solo or a full party

[AirPlay — Living Room Ready]
- AirPlay to a TV or display
- Phone to TV without a hitch — couch nights and hangouts
- Big screen plus a controller — immersion maxed out
